name: lan-reader
description: TypeScript migration of the EPUB reader. Source project D:/Projects/epub-reader is read-only.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently --names server,client --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client && node server/scripts/copyClient.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace shared && npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace client
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace shared && npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace client
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test
